# Minimal Data Studio 0.8.0
Project-local interactive apps, saved scenarios, SQL inputs and create-only DuckDB outputs.
- Open an HTML/JavaScript app folder as an interactive document, with inspectable source files and a fullscreen preview. - Register SQL files as named data inputs. Inspect, edit, run, save and explicitly refresh complete snapshots; typed query parameters keep slow queries separate from UI interaction. - Save assumptions, scenarios, notes and results with the project. Recover unsaved work after reload; incompatible app state versions preserve downloadable state. - Save scenario results as a new DuckDB table, optionally into a Database folder, without replacing existing tables or views. - Includes MDM revenue scenarios, an executive dashboard and a self-contained parameterized starter. - Fixes blank native interactive previews and keeps long native error details scrollable with a visible Close button.
## Installation and testing
For Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later. Both the application and installer are Developer ID signed, Apple-notarized and stapled. Download the DMG below. The ZIP is the equivalent app used for stable-channel updates.
Checks passed on macOS and Linux, including the full Chromium/Firefox CI suite, Python/JavaScript, relocated bundled Python/R, native WebKit app rendering, state save/restore and native state export. The portable test project contains synthetic data only.
A clean second-Mac download/portability check and physical keyboard/trackpad checks are still outstanding. Save a backup of important projects before testing; do not run two Studio versions against the same project simultaneously.
## Current boundaries
Use reviewed local app code, not arbitrary untrusted plugins. Inputs are bounded snapshots (10,000 rows per input, 1 MB combined) with a cooperative 30-second query deadline. App code runs in an isolated iframe; host-confirmed table writes are create-only. There is no automatic state migration, remote parameterized input API, dedicated cancel control, or append/replace table mode yet.
The release includes matching R, nanoparquet, psycopg and Paramiko sources and license notices. All changes remain available in the source repository.
